lines.text: How do you build a mountain out of mud?
A king of Ur did it around 2100 BC.
But mud melts in the rain.
So they wrapped the mud in baked brick, set in tar.
So they cut holes through the wall, and laid reed mats between the layers.
So the bricks were stamped with the king's name.
One now sits in the British Museum, with two dog paw prints on it.
That's how you build a mountain out of mud.
